title: Examining the growth and mobilization behavior of early-stage biofilms in a controlled, pilot scale PVC drinking water system laboratory
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00654F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Artur Sass Braga, Yves Filion, Benjamin Anderson
Early-stage biofilms were grown on the inner pipe wall of PVC pipes. Clusters were observed predominantly on pipe inverts and were able to resist pipe flushing forces.
